channel.title: Sonar
channel.description: Updates for Sonar, the menu-bar Spotify player with hybrid auto-pause.

item.title: Sonar 0.1.0
item.description:
Sonar 0.1.0

Sonar puts the current Spotify track in your macOS menu bar, with a click-to-open playback panel, and steps out of the way when something else starts making noise: it fades the music down, pauses it, and fades it back in once the room goes quiet.

Now playing

  • Artist and title in the menu bar, with app icon, playing and liked indicators.
  • Click the menu-bar item for artwork, play/pause, next, previous, like, and a scrubbable playback position.
  • Global keyboard shortcuts for play/pause, next, previous, like and unlike.
  • Compact two-row or single-row layout, with a configurable maximum width.

Auto-Pause

  • Hybrid detection: a Core Audio tap measures real loudness, and an IsRunningOutput process poll catches anything the tap misses.
  • Two presets, or your own. Fade eases the music down and back up; Instant cuts it out and back in the moment. Anything you tune yourself shows as Custom.
  • Configurable trigger delay, resume delay, fade length and loudness threshold, behind Advanced settings.
  • Per-app rules: All apps or Only these apps, with a live “heard in the last 3 minutes” finder.
  • Correct ownership: Sonar resumes only if it paused that same Spotify process. A manual pause, volume change, player restart or quit hands playback back.

Permissions

Auto-Pause needs two permissions and will not switch on without both. Preferences › Auto-Pause shows each one with its live state.

  • Screen & System Audio Recording — owns the Core Audio tap, so Sonar can measure how loud other apps are. Without it, detection falls back to process polling, which cannot tell silence from sound.
  • Automation (Apple Events) for com.spotify.client — every Spotify action is an Apple Event. It is also how the menu bar reads the current track.

Requirements

  • macOS 15.0 or later.
  • The Spotify desktop app for macOS. Premium is not required.

This is the first release of Sonar. Sonar is a fork of SpotMenu by @kmikiy (MIT); the menu-bar UI, preference panes and Spotify controller are its work, kept as-is. The Auto-Pause engine is new code on top of that base. Please report anything that misbehaves at github.com/Kathir-D/Sonar/issues.
